description: Review the changes an agent proposes to a file: a line diff computed in-house (or read from a patch), unified or side by side, changed words marked, long unchanged runs folded, and Accept or Reject on every hunk.
moves: Switching unified and split, the new layout fades in from the side of its button while the switch's key slides across.
An opened fold grows from its row to its lines, which fade in.
On mount, hunks rise in one after another (flourish).
The +added and −removed counts roll up to their values (flourish).
Accepting a hunk swaps its buttons for a tick that draws itself; a rejected hunk steps back.
The view switch, review buttons and copy key sink under the press.
keyboard: Moves to the view switch, the copy button, the body (so it can scroll), then each fold and review button.
Scroll the diff while the body has focus.
Presses the focused button: switch view, open a fold, accept, reject, undo or copy.

propDocs.DiffViewer.before: The file before the change. With after, the diff is computed in the browser (Myers, no package).
propDocs.DiffViewer.after: The file after the change. Also what the copy button copies.
propDocs.DiffViewer.patch: A unified diff (git diff), used when before and after are left out. Folds between its hunks show their size but can't open.
propDocs.DiffViewer.filename: The file name in the header. Read from the patch when left out.
propDocs.DiffViewer.language: Which tokenizer colours the code: "ts", "tsx", "js", "jsx", "json", "css", "html", "bash" or "text". Guessed from the file name by default.
propDocs.DiffViewer.defaultView: The view at first, when uncontrolled. Defaults to "unified".
propDocs.DiffViewer.onViewChange: Called with the view someone (or an agent) switched to.
propDocs.DiffViewer.splitMinWidth: Below this width in pixels the split view shows as unified. Defaults to 640.
propDocs.DiffViewer.context: Unchanged lines kept around each change. Defaults to 3.
propDocs.DiffViewer.wordDiff: Marks the words that changed inside a changed line. Defaults to true.
propDocs.DiffViewer.review: Shows Accept and Reject on every hunk. On by default when onAccept or onReject is given.
propDocs.DiffViewer.onAccept: Called with the hunk's index and the hunk when the reviewer accepts it.
propDocs.DiffViewer.onReject: Called with the hunk's index and the hunk when the reviewer rejects it.
propDocs.DiffViewer.onUndo: Called with the hunk's index and the hunk when the reviewer takes a decision back.
propDocs.DiffViewer.onCopy: Called with the text after the copy button copied it.
propDocs.DiffViewer.lineNumbers: Shows the old and new line numbers. Defaults to true.
propDocs.DiffViewer.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
